examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A bucket-like file tree three levels deep, with glyphs and size descriptions. Two folders are seeded in `v-model:open-keys`; the chevron and ArrowRight / ArrowLeft fold the rest.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: `size` sets the row density: `small` is 24px rows for dense file explorers, `medium` (the default) 32px, `large` 40px for touch or roomy panels. Height, padding, label type and indentation step together.

examples.name: Selectable
examples.summary: With `selectable`, activating a node writes its id to `v-model:selected-key`, marks the row selected and sets `aria-selected`. The bound id is shown under the tree.
